summary: The separate continuous runtime loaded final_only-medium, reused persistent dynamics and decoder caches, advanced without per-frame client inference calls, honored held-right and release state, survived pause/reset, and fit the full desktop interface inside 1440x900. A later no-response incident on the CR-DYN-0011 25k checkpoint was traced to a nanosecond verifier revision permanently outranking browser microsecond revisions in process-global state; matching clocks and restarting restored interaction. These are runtime and verifier repairs only, not terminal Dynamics quality evidence.

comparisons.changed: blocking per-frame HTTP and repeated context prefill were replaced by a continuous SSE loop, persistent KV caches and latest complete held-input state
comparisons.result: The world advanced autonomously while subscribed, held-right affected multiple generated frames, release restored no-op, and stable cached frame latency fell to about 22–25 ms.

deviations: The later CR-DYN-0011 25k smoke changed the loaded checkpoint but did not change the continuous runtime protocol. It is retained only as an input-path regression observation, not as a comparable model-quality evaluation.

failures.message: An external verifier used nanosecond revisions while the browser used microseconds. The process-global monotonic revision silently rejected later browser inputs even though the endpoint returned HTTP 200.

observed: Both remote and local-tunnel health reported protocol continuous-sse-v1 with no runtime error.
Three no-op frames advanced without any per-frame inference request from the client.
One held-right state update was observed on at least two later generated frames and a higher-revision empty state returned the observed action to no-op.
Pause and reset completed without the prior cache dtype failure.
At 1440x900 the 720x720 stage and the complete control sidebar fit without document scrolling.
interpretation: The persistent-cache model loop and held-state transport implement the intended real-time interaction semantics.
The initial JIT compilation remains a one-time startup cost; steady cached generation is fast enough for a continuously rendered browser stream.
The oversized-page defect is fixed at the preregistered desktop viewport.
The later apparent no-response failure was caused by verifier revision state, not a measured loss of model action dependence.
not_established: Visual coherence of the selected dynamics checkpoint.
Whether action conditioning was learned strongly enough to be useful.
Whether the selected checkpoint is visually coherent enough for a usable game-like experience.
Terminal visual, temporal and action quality of CR-DYN-0011, whose repaired smoke used only the 25k checkpoint.
decision: Keep CR-DEMO-0002's user rejection in force for model quality.
Use this continuous runtime and responsive layout as the demo shell for a future checkpoint that passes visual and action-quality review.
Replace or expose the process-global revision contract so stale browser inputs cannot be silently reported as successful.
